text: {"answerable": false, "answer": "The passages do not say what test system Behler and Parrinello used in their original paper. They describe the method: atomic energy decomposition with local descriptors [W4312043350#015], and symmetry-function-based networks [W2988055229#031][W2541404351#007]. They also say Behler-Parrinello networks have mainly been used to predict the same molecular system so that MD simulations can run [W2988055229#031]. The only demonstration of a Behler-Parrinello network in the passages is the JAX MD study, which fits 64-atom silicon DFT data [W2991697224#016]. That study is not the original Behler-Parrinello demonstration."}
